vad_vi_gor.text: Vi säljer inte åt andra. Varje butik är vår egen: eget namn, egen sajt, egna kunder. Går en produkt bra får den en butik byggd runt sig.
Ett eget team producerar film och bild varje dag. Det som fungerar får mer pengar, det som inte fungerar stängs av — mätt på vinst, inte på gissningar.
Sverige, Norge, Danmark, Finland, USA och Storbritannien. Butiken översätts, annonsen översätts, priset sätts i landets valuta.
Spårning som faktiskt säger var paketet är, svar på mejlen och en support som hinner med. Det avgör om kunden handlar igen.

kategorier.mening: Customers ask where their paid order is and when it will be shipped, since they haven't received it yet.

kategorier.sopTitel: Package missing after tracking shows delivered
kategorier.mening: Customers state they still have not received their ordered item and ask for an update.
Customers send miscellaneous replies, confirmations, or unrelated feedback not tied to a specific issue.
Customers ask how to return their order and request instructions or confirmation for the return process.
Customers report items arrived damaged, defective, or not as described and request a refund or replacement.

plan.titel: Respond to 12 open disputes before the deadline
plan.varfor: 5,402 SEK is on the line. 2 of them are real chargebacks, the rest are bank inquiries. The earliest evidence deadline is 2026-09-16. A dispute you do not answer is lost automatically — you lose the goods, the money and the fee.
steg: Shopify admin → Orders → filter "Disputed" → open the oldest deadline first.
For every dispute attach: tracking number + carrier scan showing delivery, the order confirmation, and the full email thread with the customer.
If the parcel genuinely never arrived: do NOT fight it. Accept the dispute and refund — fighting a lost case costs the fee on top.
Write the outcome in the order timeline so the next person sees what was sent.
plan.effekt: Every dispute answered with tracking evidence is a dispute that can be won instead of auto-lost.

plan.titel: Reply to 2 customers threatening to go to the bank
plan.varfor: 2 customers have written that they will contact their bank, Klarna or ARN. Orders: #5054. A chargeback costs the order value plus the dispute fee, and it hurts the account's dispute rate. Refunding today is cheaper than losing the case in three weeks.
steg: Reply within 24 hours, in the customer's own language.
Offer one of two things immediately and let them pick: full refund now, or a replacement shipped with tracking today.
Never ask them to "wait a few more days" — that is the sentence that turns a threat into a real chargeback.
When they accept, write it in the order notes so the case is documented if the bank still contacts us.
plan.effekt: Solving it here stops it before it reaches the card network and keeps the dispute rate down.

plan.titel: Check 4 reports of an unknown or double charge today
plan.varfor: 4 customers say they were charged twice or for something they do not recognise. Orders: #6076, #6311. This is the number one "unauthorized transaction" chargeback reason and banks side with the customer almost every time.
steg: Search the customer email in Shopify → Orders. Two orders with the same items minutes apart = a real double charge.
Refund the duplicate the same day, then email the customer telling them it is done and when the money lands (3–5 banking days).
If there is only one order: send them the order confirmation and the exact text that appears on their statement, so they recognise it.
plan.effekt: A refunded duplicate never becomes a chargeback. An unanswered one almost always does.

plan.titel: Clear the backlog: 192 tickets have waited more than 48 h
plan.varfor: 195 of 293 tickets are unanswered, 192 of them past 48 h and the oldest has waited 716 h. 153 of them are in chargeback-prone categories (never delivered, unknown charge, threats). Silence is what turns a support ticket into a dispute.
steg: Work the list on the dashboard top-down — it is already sorted with the dangerous ones first (153 of them).
Every ticket gets a reply today, even if the answer is "I am checking this, you will hear from me tomorrow" — a holding reply stops the clock.
Anything older than 14 days: refund or reship without asking. The goodwill is worth less than the dispute fee.
Mark a ticket done only when the customer has been answered, not when you have read it.
plan.effekt: Getting these to zero removes the biggest single driver of the 100/100 risk score.

plan.titel: Resolve 86 "never arrived" tickets with a hard rule
plan.varfor: 86 customers say their parcels never arrived (66 still unanswered). Orders: #4579, #5144, #5167, #5233, #4881, #5120, #5002, #5162 and 23 more. "Item not received" is the most common chargeback reason in e-commerce, and the clock is already running on every one of these.
steg: Open the tracking for each order. Three outcomes, three answers — decide in the same reply, never "we will look into it".
Tracking moving: send the link and the expected delivery date. Done.
Tracking stuck more than 7 days, or says delivered but customer has not got it: reship with tracking, or refund. Customer chooses.
No tracking at all on the order: refund immediately — that case cannot be won in a dispute.
plan.effekt: Each one resolved here is one less chargeback in 2–6 weeks, when the bank case would have landed.

plan.titel: Answer 10 open bank inquiries — they become chargebacks if ignored
plan.varfor: An inquiry is the bank asking us for the order details before the customer files a real dispute. It is the cheapest possible stage to win: no fee, no lost goods. 10 are open right now.
steg: Shopify admin → Orders → Disputes → open each inquiry.
Submit the same evidence pack as a chargeback: tracking + delivery scan + order confirmation + email thread.
Also email the customer directly — most inquiries come from people who simply did not recognise the charge.
plan.effekt: An inquiry answered with evidence usually closes without ever becoming a chargeback or costing a fee.
